text: 银河证券策略研究解读《关于发展新质生产力的意见》称，本次顶层文件对A股市场的影响兼具短期风险偏好修复效应与中长期估值体系重构价值。长期来看，本次顶层文件从产业主线定位、投融资机制完善、估值逻辑重塑等维度，对A股市场形成制度性重塑：一是巩固新质生产力作为资本市场长期主线的地位，引导资金向创新产业倾斜，科技硬资产的长期定价权重抬升；二是重构估值体系，强化创新溢价，引导市场估值体系向具备核心技术壁垒、持续研发投入、真实产业化能力的创新龙头集中；三是扩容耐心资本，增厚优质科创资产供给，优化资本市场投融资生态。板块层面，关注“卡脖子”硬科技、AI场景应用、能源绿色
text_en: Galaxy Securities strategy research interpreted the "Opinions on Developing New Quality Productive Forces" as saying that this top-level document's impact on the A-share market combines short-term risk appetite repair effects with medium- to long-term valuation system reconstruction value. In the long term, this top-level document forms an institutional reshaping of the A-share market from dimensions including industrial mainline positioning, improvement of investment and financing mechanisms, and reshaping of valuation logic: first, consolidating the position of new quality productive forces as the long-term mainline of the capital market, guiding capital toward innovative industries, and raising the long-term pricing weight of hard technology assets; second, reconstructing the valuation system, strengthening the innovation premium, and guiding the market valuation system to concentrate on innovative leaders with core technical barriers, sustained R&D investment, and genuine industrialization capabilities; third, expanding patient capital, increasing the supply of high-quality sci-tech innovation assets, and optimizing the capital market investment and financing ecosystem. At the sector level, pay attention to "bottleneck" hard technology, AI scenario applications, and green energy
